notes.title: Tachyon Wars v1.2
notes.notes:
This upgrade is designed to enhance your gameplay experience, ensuring seamless navigation and management of your interstellar armadas. Dive into the action and enjoy the smoother, more intuitive controls!

Less clicks more action!

And even more exciting news for all gamers! We're offering an incredible 50% discount on Tachyon Wars, inviting even more players to experience the game and share their thoughts on the enhanced gameplay. Don't miss this chance to join the adventure at half the price!

notes.title: Minor upgrade.
notes.notes:
To reduce clicks intensity I added few hotkeys, mainly around Fleet Control UI. Also, game now better chooses the expected command when fleet targets something.

Plus few minor upgrades and bugfixes.

notes.title: Major Tachyon Wars update
notes.notes:
[h1]Update + discount!ːsteamhappyː[/h1]

This is the long-expected major Tachyon Wars update that delivers much deeper gameplay than it ever was before. The changes are:

[h2]Multiplayer game[/h2]
The real-time game flow was designed with online games in mind and so it's finally coming.
Play over the internet a cooperative game with your friends against AI, or make a PvP. Or mix it the way you want - pair against pair? Sure - ally with an AI and attack a rival alliance.

[h2]Race customization[/h2]
Long-awaited race customization is now available. Create custom races in single-player and multiplayer games. Quite a few fancy traits to choose from!

[h2]Stronger AI[/h2]
AI is now much more challenging and smarter in many ways - it won't let you fall into boredom.

[h2]And everything else[/h2]
Bugfixes, rebalancing, UI improvements, better tutorials, save games, optimizations, and more.

And even more, we are celebrating this update with a massive 50% discount (starting Sep 19, 10:00 am PST). Don't miss it out!

We are also delivering a series of guide videos and published one full gameplay video, from the race creation to the victory screen. Please enjoy the videos here:
https://www.youtube.com/user/TachyonWars/videos
